name: admiral
description:
Admiral is software for the people who run Google and Meta ads. Connect it and ask about the ad account you chose, in plain language: what the campaigns cost, which keywords are wasting money, which search terms brought nothing, and how the week is trending.

It can also put a suggestion into Admiral's approval queue (pause a keyword, add a negative, stop an ad), where you decide on each one. It cannot change anything in Google or Meta by itself, it cannot move a budget, and it cannot spend money. A person approves every change in Admiral.

You choose the single ad account the connection may read when you authorize it, and you can disconnect it at any time under Settings.

defaultPrompt: Which search terms are wasting money?
Show me the daily spend for the last two weeks.

positive.description: Campaign costs for the connected account
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_campaigns and lists each campaign with its status, budget and its 30-day spend total; the per-campaign totals add up to the account total.

positive.description: Search terms that cost money and converted nothing
positive.prompt: Which search terms are wasting money?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_search_terms and lists costly search terms with zero conversions, highest cost first.

positive.description: This month against the period before
positive.prompt: How is this month tracking against last?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_account_overview and compares totals on the two labelled bases it returns: window (last 30 calendar days) and lifetime.

positive.prompt: Show me the daily spend for the last two weeks.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_daily_history with days set to 14 and shows one row per day with spend, clicks and conversions.

positive.prompt: That keyword is fine now, close the suggestion about it.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_open_proposals to find the open suggestion, then resolve_proposal with its dedup_key and a one-sentence reason, and confirms it is closed.

negative.description: Asked to change a campaign directly
negative.expected_behavior: Does not claim to pause anything. No tool changes a campaign; it may file a suggestion with file_proposal and must say that a person approves it in Admiral.

negative.prompt: Raise the daily budget to 5,000 rupees.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses. There is no budget tool and no permission to spend; it says so rather than claiming anything was queued.

negative.description: Asked about an account the connection was not given
negative.prompt: Show me my other ad account's numbers.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses. The connection reads exactly one ad account, chosen at authorization; the honest answer is to reconnect and choose the other account.

publication.release_notes: First release of Admiral in ChatGPT. Ask about the Google or Meta ad account you choose, in plain language, and put suggestions into Admiral's approval queue, where a person approves each one.
